description: TypeScript definitions for calendar weekly view state, actions, and related types in a scheduling application.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the calendar state from public props without overriding internal state.

methods.name: setView
methods.description: Sets the current calendar view (month, week, day).

methods.name: setStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the calendar view.

methods.name: setEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the calendar view.

methods.name: setEvents
methods.description: Updates the list of calendar events.

methods.name: setSelectedEvent
methods.description: Sets the currently selected calendar event.

methods.name: handleDateChange
methods.description: Handles incrementing or decrementing the date range.
